source: Coordinator's brief for 8.0.0-beta.6, 2026-11-21 (the properties review, items 22, 23 and 26; memory by heap share); RFC 0006 §9.3
statement: Each revocation table's local copy (`RevokedTokenCache`, `RevokedSubjectCache`) holds the revocation tables' share of the heap (`STA-12`), counted in entries of their measured size (290 and 230 bytes): the starter declares the count, and CoSec locks it, so neither `cocache.defaults.store.*` nor a customizer changes it, and a `cocache.caches.[name]` property that sets it fails startup. A smaller copy only sends more revocation reads to Redis; it never answers "not revoked" for longer.
guards: spring-boot:RevocationCachePrecedenceTest#each table holds the revocation tables' share of the heap, over cocache defaults
spring-boot:RevocationCachePrecedenceTest#a per-cache property cannot set the count
